Private Function Safe(ByVal target As Object, ByVal name As String) As String
    Dim v As Variant
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If IsObject(CallByName(target, name, VbGet)) Then
        Safe = TypeName(CallByName(target, name, VbGet))
    Else
        v = CallByName(target, name, VbGet): Safe = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    End If
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Safe = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal kind As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object, i As Long, j As Long, s As String, t As String
    Dim names As Variant
    names = Array("Parent", "Application", "Creator", "AxisGroup", "ChartType", "Type", "IsFiltered", "HasErrorBars", "Has3DEffect", "BarShape", "PlotColorIndex", "PictureType", "PictureUnit2")
    names = Split(Join(names, ",") & ",InvertColorIndex,InvertColor,ApplyPictToFront,ApplyPictToSides,ApplyPictToEnd,Shadow,ValueSortOrder,QuartileCalculationInclusiveMedian,GeoMappingLevel,GeoProjectionType,RegionLabelOption,ParentDataLabelOption,SeriesColorGradientStyle", ",")
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6))
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    ch.ChartType = kind
    For i = 1 To 2
        t = ""
        For j = LBound(names) To UBound(names)
            t = t & "," & Safe(ch.SeriesCollection(i), names(j))
        Next
        s = s & "|" & Mid(t, 2)
    Next
    Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    wb.Close False
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim s As String
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(xlColumnClustered)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(xlColumnStacked)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(xlBarClustered)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(xlLine)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(xlLineMarkers)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(xlPie)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(xlDoughnut)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(xlArea)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(xlXYScatter)
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
